intended_use: Generate SYNTHETIC cohorts for population-level health awareness. Outcome: elevated glucose (proxy), random capillary glucose >= 200 mg/dL. Not a diagnosis, not an individual risk.

data.test_split: locked; not used for training or model selection
data.scope: complete_conditions (glucose known AND bmi_measured == 1 AND hypertension known)

limitations: Trained only on respondents with glucose, measured BMI and known hypertension status.
Unspecified conditions are filled from independent marginals.
What-if = how the synthetic cohort shifts, not a causal intervention.
No external validation dataset (NMB-2017 has no data file).
